question: In which year was the Amateur Athletics Federation of India (AAFI), responsible for managing Indian Athletics, established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1946**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Amateur Athletics Federation of India (AAFI) was founded in **1946** as the governing body for athletics in India.
 
• AAFI is responsible for managing, promoting, and developing track and field athletics across the country.
